|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Either Way, You Win (V)]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023) (PDF created 17 June 2023), cut unchanged from page 7. The current text is [[Either Way, You Win (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Either Way, You Win (V)]]): the card image at official release (18 June 2023)<ref name="ht-04fafe9">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c 04fafe9] “Set 21 plus stuff”, 18 June 2023.</ref> prints: “If [Tatooine] or [Coruscant] Qui-Gon in battle, he is power +1 for each ‘credit.’ OR Once per game, if a battle just initiated at Watto’s Junkyard involving Qui-Gon, target a character. Lightsabers may not be fired this battle. Unless target is Watto or a Dark Jedi, cancel target’s game text.”<ref name="cj-1ad7bd9">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1ad7bd9 swccg-card-json commit 1ad7bd9] “all of the LS V21 cards” (17 June 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 7, file created 17 June 2023: “If [Tatooine] or [Coruscant] Qui-Gon in battle, he is power +1 for each 'credit.' OR Once per game, if a battle just initiated at Watto's Junkyard involving Qui-Gon, target a character. Lightsabers may not be fired this battle. Unless target is Watto or a Dark Jedi, cancel target's game text.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Either Way, You Win (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Either Way, You Win”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Either Way, You Win (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Either Way, You Win]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Either Way, You Win (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-e02f932">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/eitherwayyouwin.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b e02f932] “LS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “Each player may choose to play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect or to exchange a card in hand with one of their race destinies. [Immune to Sense] OR If a battle involving Qui-Gon was just initiated at a junkyard, weapons may not be fired this battle.”<ref name="cj-4a981d6">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4a981d6 swccg-card-json commit 4a981d6] “Light - Tweak Set 2026” (15 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The whole text was replaced. Both old options (Qui-Gon power +1 for each ‘credit’, and the once-per-game Watto’s Junkyard option that stopped lightsabers and canceled a target’s game text) were removed. The new text is “Each player may choose to play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect or to exchange a card in hand with one of their race destinies. [Immune to Sense] OR If a battle involving Qui-Gon was just initiated at a junkyard, weapons may not be fired this battle.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
